heading: CAMINO HENRO
subtitle: From the End of the Earth to the Land of the Rising Sun
manifestoDivider: 哲学の道 • THE PILGRIM'S MANIFESTO
manifestoQuoteLine1: A boy and a hat set out on a journey to cross a continent and discover a world(view) where money, jobs and human society are simply another part of Nature.
manifestoQuoteLine2: We have never left Nature — we've merely forgotten that everything is, inevitably, Nature. ☯️
manifestoQuoteLine3: For the hat, a homecoming — its very own Odyssey.
manifestoQuoteLine4: For the boy, a rite of initiation, and the beginning of a journey into manhood.
manifestoBodyHtml: Modern life surrounds us with financial instruments, insurance policies, and digital vaults—yet anxiety over basic survival remains sharper than ever. Camino Henro is a cross-continental philosophical pilgrimage on foot from Finisterra, Spain to Shikoku, Japan, investigating a single foundational question: What is the true philosophical foundation for building a sense of material security in life?
courtyardDivider: 広場 • FROM THE PILGRIM'S COURTYARD

fallbackPopular.title: On Sufficiency vs. Surplus: Where Does Preparation End and Fear Begin?
fallbackPopular.content: When walking across a continent with everything on your back, every extra ounce is a physical confession of a fear you have not yet made peace with. How do we distinguish wise stewardship from anxiety?

fallbackLatest.content: As the autumn frost settles over the stone paths, what minimalist wool and rain shell combinations have proven resilient without burdening the pack beyond six kilograms?
